map-first-tcp-udp-protocol: service.protocol: a tcp listener carries a stream; its service is ssh, http, https, vnc, rdp or tcp (its first listener, rtsp, is tcp)
map-first-udp-tcp-protocol: service.protocol: a udp listener's service is udp, not tcp (its first listener, rtp, is udp)
map-health-ports: health.listen: a binds a range; health probes a listener with one port or socket
map-health-udp: health.listen: b is a udp listener, with no connection to probe
map-health-unknown: health.listen: b is not a listener
map-health-unnamed: health.listen: with several listeners, health names the one it probes
map-port-setting-without-range: listen.web.port: ${setting.port} names a port: its min and max are within 1-65535
map-ports-past-65535: listen.rtp.ports: 65530-70000 is not a range low-high, 1 <= low < high <= 65535
map-ports-reversed: listen.rtp.ports: 5005-5004 is not a range low-high, 1 <= low < high <= 65535
map-ports-with-service-port: service.port: a service of a ports listener is reached on its listeners' ports; it names none
map-remoteit-listen: the manifest: ${remoteit.listen} is given only with one listen object; with named listeners, ${remoteit.listen.<name>.port|path}
map-remoteit-port: the manifest: ${remoteit.port} is given only with one listen object; with named listeners, ${remoteit.listen.<name>.port}
map-service-unknown-listener: service.listen: api is not a listener
map-several-with-auto-port: service.listen: a has no known port (a number, ${setting.X} or ports); a service of several ports is reached on its listeners' own
map-several-with-service-port: service.port: a service of several listeners is reached on its listeners' ports; it names none
map-stdio-not-alone: listen.shell: a stdio listener runs the app per connection; it is the app's only listener
map-tcp-port-in-range: listen.b: its tcp ports overlap a's
map-tcp-service-no-port: service.port: a tcp service whose app listens on no fixed port names the port people connect to
map-udp-ranges-overlap: listen.b: its udp ports overlap a's
map-unix-with-another: service.listen: sock is a unix listener, reached only as its service's one listener
map-value-path-of-tcp: the manifest: ${remoteit.listen.web.path} is given only for a unix listener
map-value-ports-of-one-port: the manifest: ${remoteit.listen.web.ports} is given only for a listener with ports
map-value-unknown-listener: the manifest: ${remoteit.listen.api.port} names no listener (api is not one)
single-listener-value: the manifest: ${remoteit.listen.web.port} is given only with named listeners (with one listen object: ${remoteit.port}, ${remoteit.listen})
single-port-setting-without-range: listen.port: ${setting.port} names a port: its min and max are within 1-65535
single-stdio-health: health: a stdio app runs per connection; there is nothing to probe
single-tcp-service-no-port: service.port: a tcp service whose app listens on no fixed port names the port people connect to
single-tcp-udp-protocol: service.protocol: a tcp listener carries a stream; its service is ssh, http, https, vnc, rdp or tcp
single-udp-health: health: a udp app has no connection to probe; a running process is running
single-udp-http: service.protocol: a udp listener's service is udp, not http
